purpose: NORTH 3-frame walk cycle (walk_north_1/2/3.png) + EAST 2-frame walk cycle (walk_east_1/2.png) -- first attachment round (WEST's own 2 frames arrive separately; see the west registration meta for those).

walk_east_1.file: user-attached image 4 (3/4 profile, face/mask visible facing screen-right, matches east_idle.png's orientation)

walk_east_2.file: user-attached image 5 (3/4 profile, same orientation as image 4, later walk-cycle stride)

processing: Non-generative only -- no AI redraw/regeneration/reshaping. Two deterministic steps per source image, same method as the existing south_walk_build_meta.json: (1) white-background un-premultiply (alpha cleanup), (2) landmark-based scale+anchor onto the existing shared 700x920 boss canvas, referenced against the SAME-DIRECTION existing idle image (north_idle.png / east_idle.png) per explicit instruction.

step1_white_unblend.problem: Each source PNG already carried a real alpha channel, but (same signature as the earlier south_walk batch) it was reconstructed by flattening over a white background without un-premultiplying the RGB -- edge/antialiased pixels kept their white-blended color. Verified by bucketing edge pixels by alpha value: mean brightness rose from ~65-105 at alpha 200-250 up to ~215-221 at alpha 3-30 for both a north-facing and an east-facing sample image.
step1_white_unblend.formula: For every pixel with alpha>0: true_color = clip((RGB_stored - (1-alpha/255)*255) / (alpha/255), 0, 255); alpha itself is kept as-is. Pixels with alpha==0 are zeroed. Identical formula to south_walk_build_meta.json's step1.
step1_white_unblend.verification: Visually confirmed via composites over a dark near-black background (matching the actual in-game background tone) -- no white/gray halo on wing-feather or claw edges.

step2_landmark_scale_anchor.method: For each new image: alpha-scan restricted to an x-band around the character's own head (chosen per-image to exclude the wing, which sits at a very different x-range in every pose) to find head_top_y and head_center_x (midpoint of that top row's opaque span, WITHIN the band only); feet_bottom_y is the image's own overall alpha-bbox max-y (the lowest claw/toe pixel). native_body_span = feet_bottom_y - head_top_y.
step2_landmark_scale_anchor.note_targets: feet_bottom_y=900 matches the anchor=[350,900] convention already documented in sprite_build_meta.json/south_walk_build_meta.json for every existing boss frame -- unchanged, not a new value.
step2_landmark_scale_anchor.placement_formula: paste_x = round(target_head_center_x - native_head_center_x*scale); paste_y = round(target_feet_bottom_y - native_feet_bottom_y*scale); pasted onto a fresh transparent 700x920 canvas.

verification_on_final_canvas.note: All 5 land within 1-2px of their direction's target -- no per-frame jump in size, position, or foot anchor, and no clipping against the 700x920 canvas edges (checked: none of the 5 touch x=0/699 or y=0/919).

step2_landmark_scale_anchor.wing_claw_exclusion: Per explicit instruction, the wings and claws (which extend far beyond the body's own silhouette and vary in reach between poses) were deliberately excluded from the scale-matching landmarks -- only head-top-to-feet-bottom span and head-center-x (a proxy for the torso's own horizontal position) were used, exactly as for every prior boss sprite batch.

animation_wiring: NOT YET WIRED into bossFrameName()/updateBoss() -- deferred until the WEST pair (walk_west_1/2) arrives in the second attachment round, so all three new directions' walk cycles are wired and tested together in one pass, per explicit instruction.
in_game_scale: No per-frame draw()-time scale multiplier applied yet (unlike SOUTH_WALK_SCALE/NORTH_IDLE_SCALE/etc.) -- decided at wiring time once the full north/east/west cycle is in place and can be screenshot-compared against the existing idle/attack/defense renders together.
dark_phase_exclusion: Will follow the existing pattern once wired: DARK PHASE never draws any normal battle sprite, north/east/west walk frames included -- see drawBossDarkPhase().
